motion.name: ease-broadcast
motion.purpose: Lower-third wipe, score step, progress width, and toast travel.

motion.name: wipe
motion.purpose: A new question's lower-third uncovers from the left edge toward the right.

motion.name: bugstep
motion.purpose: The corner score numeral steps up when points land, clipped by the bug.

motion.name: progress
motion.purpose: The cream progress fill advances on the broadcast curve.

motion.name: toast
motion.purpose: The points toast fades and travels 6px, then clears after 1.1s.

motion.name: confetti
motion.purpose: 22 rectangles, 8×12, in amber, cream, green, and standby gray, on streak 3, streak 5, and a new record.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Drops the wipe, the score step, confetti, the toast travel, and the progress transition.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Amber continue slab. Held state is #e0ad08. No hover fill.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Hairline slab for the in-round pair. The inset seam outranks the focus halo; the cream outline remains.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The same hairline as secondary, full width, for the way back to the home screen.

components.name: Era Chip
components.description: Two square halves. The selected era is the amber slab.

components.name: Mode Row
components.description: Home navigation row. Title leads, personal best is a tabular Secular One numeral, caption under it.

components.name: Answer Slab
components.description: Cream choice slab. Correct and wrong carry a drawn mark as well as the result color. Dim is the unchosen rest.

components.name: Score Bug
components.description: Corner score slab. The numeral is Secular One, tabular, and steps up when points land.

components.name: Lower Third
components.description: The question plate: one amber bar on one cream field. The bar uncovers from the right edge toward the left.

narrative.overview:
כדורגל טריוויה is a ten-question Hebrew football quiz drawn as a 1990s Israeli sports broadcast on a single phone. Night Navy is the studio shell. Programme Cream is the card and the primary continue button. Broadcast Amber is the live signal: the selected era, the question lower-third, the corner score, the final score band, the points toast, and text selection.

The column is square, dense, and flat. Secular One carries the name and the scoreboard figures. Heebo carries every question, choice, and caption. Regions meet at a 1px seam. A resolved answer is a Pitch Green or Wrong Red slab with a drawn mark. The question plate has one job, and a long career scrolls inside it. Quit is an unmarked icon button, held apart from the amber score.

The world keeps the broadcast and drops the costume. There is no emoji, no television bezel, no sticker-album chrome, and no toto-coupon grid. Depth comes from the three stacked fields, not from shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Night Navy shell, Programme Cream field, Broadcast Amber signal
Secular One for the name and the figures; Heebo for play
Square slabs and 1px seams, without drop shadows
Hebrew, RTL, one phone column at most 480px
A resolved answer is a drawn mark and a color together

rules.name: The Amber Signal Rule
rules.body: Broadcast Amber marks what is live: the selected era, the lower-third, the corner score, the final score band, the points toast, and text selection. The continue button, the new-record line, resting rows, unchosen answers, captions, and the progress fill stay cream or navy.

rules.name: The Result Pair Rule
rules.body: Pitch Green and Wrong Red appear only after an answer resolves, on that slab and on the feedback bar. They are never decoration, and they never appear on the shell.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Secular One is the broadcast face: the name, the end title, the final score, the corner bug, the clock, the streak count, personal bests, the end-of-round stats, the new-record line, and the points toast. Heebo sets every question, choice, mode row, button, caption, and feedback line.

rules.name: The Tabular Figure Rule
rules.body: Scores, the clock, the question count, career years, and personal bests use tabular figures, so a changing numeral holds its width. The corner bug also clips the numeral (`overflow: hidden`) so the step reads as a rolling digit.

rules.name: The Phone Column Rule
rules.body: The interface is one RTL column, at most 480px, full viewport height. On the play screen the score and the answers stay pinned, and the question plate is the only scroller.

rules.name: The Flat Seam Rule
rules.body: Depth is the stack of navy, cream, and amber. A seam is a 1px line or a 1px inset ring. A drop shadow is out of the system. The focus ring is focus, not elevation.

rules.name: The Square Slab Rule
rules.body: Radius stays 0. A control is a slab, a divider is a 1px seam, and a thick colored edge is not a substitute for either.

rules.name: The Mark As Well As Color Rule
rules.body: A correct answer draws a check and a wrong answer draws a cross, 16px, in the slab's own type color, beside the green or red fill. Feedback text repeats the result in a full-width slab of the same color. Color is never the only signal.

dos: **Do** set Hebrew RTL (`lang="he"`, `dir="rtl"`) and paint the shell Night Navy (`#071428`), including the browser `theme-color`.
**Do** self-host Secular One and variable Heebo from `app/fonts`. Secular One is the name and the scoreboard figures. Heebo is every question, choice, row, and caption.
**Do** keep every slab square and meet edges with a 1px seam: `rgba(244, 240, 230, 0.22)` on the shell, `rgba(16, 32, 51, 0.14)` on the cream field.
**Do** give Broadcast Amber to the selected era, the lower-third, the score bug, the final score band, the points toast, and text selection. The continue button and שיא חדש stay Programme Cream.
**Do** resolve an answer as Pitch Green or Wrong Red plus a drawn 16px check or cross.
**Do** keep targets at least 44px tall: the icon button and the score bug at 44px, era chips at 48px, answers and text buttons at 52px.
**Do** draw focus as a 2px cream outline, offset 3px, with `box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px` Night Navy.
**Do** honor `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` by turning off the lower-third wipe, the score step, the toast travel, confetti, and the progress width transition.
donts: **Don't** render emoji or the data `emoji` field. Draw icons as inline SVG with a 1.75 stroke and round caps.
**Don't** add a drop shadow, a gradient, a rounded pill, or a television bezel around the column.
**Don't** place a label above the name. The masthead is the name, and the tagline sits under it.
**Don't** use amber on a resting mode row, an unchosen answer, a caption, or the progress fill. The progress fill is Programme Cream.
**Don't** load Inter, a system display face, or a remote font. Arial Hebrew and Arial are fallbacks behind Heebo only.
**Don't** state correct or wrong by color alone.
**Don't** nest a second card inside the question plate. One amber lower-third sits on one cream field.
